---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, improvement, or new move/character/tool
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What's missing or could be better**
A clear description of the gap or the pain point.

**What you'd like instead**
What you'd want the app to do. A sketch, reference, or example from another game/tool helps.

**Why it matters**
Who this helps and when it comes up (a specific fight, edit, or workflow is more useful than "would be nice").

**Anything else**

---
Tag it with whichever area fits best, alongside `enhancement`: `character`, `move`, `fx`, `editor`, `ui`, or `discord`. Opening this issue also posts it to the project's Discord `#feature-requests` channel automatically — no need to cross-post it yourself.
